events.name: Bash
events.head: Compare web copy and 4K master mtime and duration
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-walkthroughs/scripts/walkthroughs 2>/dev/null || cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-walkthroughs; for t in kie stripe hubspot zoho wistia; do w=$(find . -path "*wt-review/$t/web/$t.mp4" | head -1); m=$(find . -name "$t-4k.mp4" -path "*wt-review/$t/*" | head -1); d(){ ffprobe -v error -show_entries format=duration -of csv=p=0 "$1"; }; echo "$t web $(stat -f %Sm -t %m%d%H%M "$w") $(d "$w") master $(stat -f %Sm -t %m%d%H%M "$m") $(d "$m")"; done; git -C /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-walkthroughs status --short | wc -l; git -C /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-walkthroughs log
